content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@x, Real)), list-partial(Analysis.contLeftAt(F, x), Analysis.contRightAt(F, x)), Logic.and(Set.mem(x, Analysis.domain(F)), Analysis.limLeft(F, @y, x, Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), x))))
content.markdown: Left-continuity at `x₀` asks that the left limit exist and equal `F.map x₀`; right-continuity uses the right limit. `F` is continuous at `x₀` iff it is both left- and right-continuous there.
